findings.message: Outside T4.9 (sources hygiene): words.w7.sources lists mw-kashi, and words.w8.sources lists mw-kala and mw-bhairava. None of the three has an excerpt in research/kalabhairava-ashtakam/v4/sources/. Annotation a2's word 'fearsome' also rests on bhairava ('frightful, terrible'), which has no v4 excerpt. That word sits next to the [dark](#v3-a2) link, so the v3 note may cover it. A human should either copy these dictionary excerpts into the v4 evidence or drop the source ids.
